jobs.title: Bilingual Accounts Receivable Specialist – Call Center
jobs.description_text: Our story began with a passionate idea that we could change the world.... And to be honest, we’ve never stopped believing that... In 1986 it was a simple concept that microbiology teamed with innovation and clinical contribution could eliminate an issue that was profoundly impacting the healthcare industry – HIV acquired through needle-stick injuries. In Australia, we lived out our dream. Investing years into R&D to create the safest containment system in the world and taking on the industry status quo to petition for higher standards in sharps protection, we witnessed an 80+ percent reduction in disposal-related needlestick injuries nationwide. And then we kept going... We are looking to bring on a Bilingual Accounts Receivable Specialist to our growing team in Canada. This can be a fully remote position and this person can live anywhere in Canada.

jobs.description_text: The Work The Content Manager, Reverse Mortgage is responsible for building and managing an always-on content engine that helps EQ Bank grow its reverse mortgage business across both the broker and direct-to-consumer channels. The role combines strategy, editorial leadership and hands-on execution to create a consistent flow of clear, credible and useful content across written, digital and traditional formats. This role owns content planning across the full reverse mortgage decision system: homeowners, mortgage brokers and key influencers, particularly adult children. Grounded in the reverse mortgage growth strategy, the Content Manager will translate complex product information into audience- and stage-specific content that builds permission for homeowners, reassurance for families and confidence for brokers. A central focus is the direct-to-consumer funnel, with content intentionally designed to move prospects from awareness and education through consideration, nurture, application and advocacy.

jobs.title: Corporate Secretary
jobs.description_text: Purpose of the Job The Corporate Secretary, reporting to the General Counsel, is the Bank’s senior governance officer and a trusted advisor to the Board of Directors, Board Chair, Committee Chairs, Chief Executive Officer and executive leadership. The role safeguards the integrity of EQB’s governance framework, enables effective Board decision-making and ensures EQB Inc., Equitable Bank and their subsidiaries meet applicable corporate, securities, stock exchange and financial institution governance obligations. The Corporate Secretary leads the enterprise governance agenda, establishes governance standards, advises on complex Board and Committee matters and oversees corporate records, public-company reporting and insider compliance. The role ensures Board decisions are clearly documented, communicated and implemented, and operates with significant independence, discretion and judgment.

jobs.title: Creative Director, Head of Internal Agency
jobs.description_text: The Work EQ Bank is building a creative engine inside the business with the taste, speed and ambition of a modern brand studio. As Creative Director / Head of Internal Agency, you will set the creative standard for how EQ Bank shows up every day: in product stories, owned channels, social, editorial, presentations, partner materials and the internal work that helps teams move faster. The studio’s job is to do more than move requests through the system; it should raise the quality, clarity and distinctiveness of the work EQ Bank puts into the world. The ambition is to make EQ Bank’s everyday creative output feel as considered and distinctive as its biggest brand moments. You will lead the ideas, craft, people and operating rhythm that turn business priorities into work people actually notice, understand and want to engage with.

jobs.title: Credit Coordinator
jobs.description_text: Why Join EQ — and Why This Role at Bennington Financial Corp Matters At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Joining Bennington means: Being part of the EQ family, with the stability, scale, and purpose of a leading Canadian challenger bank, Working within a specialized, entrepreneurial business where your contributions are highly visible and impactful, Supporting a business that operates at the intersection of bank-grade governance and commercial finance agility, Helping shape compliance, risk, and operational excellence in a business that directly enables Canadian companies to grow This role offers the best of both worlds: the backing, resources, and long-term vision of EQ, combined with the pace, ownership, and influence that comes from working within a focused subsidiary like Bennington. jobs.title: Director, Change Enablement
jobs.description_text: The Work The Director, Change Enablement advances EQ Bank’s enterprise Change Enablement practice, a standing capability within People & Talent accountable for readiness, adoption and sustained behaviour change across the Bank’s concurrent transformation agenda. The role closes the gap between funded transformation delivery and the employee readiness required to realize value across enterprise AI, PC Financial integration and convergence, and the EQB 2.0 operating model. Reporting to the Vice President, Talent, Transformation & Design, the incumbent owns the enterprise change method, demand prioritization, adoption readiness and executive-level visibility of change saturation. The mandate is to identify, plan, sequence and land change with the business, making adoption an engineered outcome rather than a communications task applied at go-live.

jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing, Reverse Mortgage
jobs.description_text: The Work The Director, Product Marketing, Reverse Mortgage (REM) leads product marketing, supports go-to-market strategy and growth for EQ Bank’s Reverse Mortgage business. This role defines market positioning, customer value propositions and go-to-market strategies that build awareness, drive acquisition, deepen engagement and support portfolio growth across direct-to-consumer channels and business-to-business channels, including mortgage brokers, financial advisors and referral partners. As the primary marketing partner to the Reverse Mortgage business, the Director works closely with Product, Sales, Customer Experience, Digital, Operations, Enterprise Marketing and external partners to bring products and capabilities to market, sharpen competitive differentiation and deliver strong customer and partner experiences. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution. The successful candidate will translate customer, market and competitive insights into effective marketing strategies, lead a high-performing team and foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, collaboration and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Director, Strategy, Risk and Business Operations
jobs.description_text: The Work Reporting to the VP, Decumulation, the Director, Strategy, Risk & Business Operations is responsible for leading the strategic planning, business performance and enablement, governance, and risk management functions for the Reverse Mortgage and Insurance Lending business. Acting as the operational and strategic leader to the VP, Decumulation, this role ensures the business maintains a robust risk and control environment while delivering on growth, profitability, and customer objectives. The Director will oversee enterprise and business-specific risk activities including risk appetite monitoring, credit, operational, compliance, legal, conduct, model, and reputational risks. This leader will act as the primary liaison between the business and corporate Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Audit, Governance and other business related risk functions such as Fraud Management while ensuring the business meets all regulatory, governance, and board reporting obligations. In addition, the Director will lead annual strategic planning, financial forecasting, business performance management, executive and Board reporting, KPI development, , enterprise initiatives, business enablement programs, and the development of new products and growth opportunities. The role requires a unique combination of strategic leadership, analytical rigor, operational execution, governance expertise, and cross-functional influence.

The incumbent acts as a key liaison with banking service providers and internal stakeholders to ensure banking transactions, reporting, and operational processes are executed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with established policies and controls.

Provides subject matter expertise and oversight of criminal risk by following a disciplined and intelligence-based approach to detection and research of activities and events in alignment with EQ Bank’s fraud program and standards to ensure compliance as well as support trending, analysis and insights generation.

jobs.title: Manager, Commercial Portfolio Management (BES)

Key responsibilities include, prudent oversight of the BES portfolio, adjudicating credit requests including ensuring credit risk is assessed thoroughly, adhering to established policies, procedures, and meeting compliance and control requirements.

jobs.title: Manager, Model Validation
jobs.description_text: The Work The Manager, Model Validation reports to the Director, Model Risk Management and supports the delivery of model validation activities across the Bank. The role executes validation procedures, contributes to validation strategies, and supports the effective management of model risk in accordance with the Bank's Model Risk Management Framework and applicable regulatory requirements. The scope includes models used for credit and treasury risk management, including AIRB and IFRS 9 ECL, interest rate risk, liquidity risk, and stress testing approaches used to support ICAAP. The role works closely with model risk stakeholders and conducts detailed reviews of model methodologies, assumptions, intended use, limitations, inputs, implementation, and performance. Responsibilities include completing benchmark and outcome analyses, documenting issues and recommendations, drawing evidence-based conclusions, and preparing model validation reports in accordance with the Bank's Model Risk Management Framework (MRMF). The primary focus is the execution of model validation activities, with additional support provided for model governance activities such as regulatory self-assessments, annual attestations, and risk reporting.

The Manager will play a crucial role in supporting the model implementation and risk delivery, and shape its future in the Bank. With the multidisciplinary nature of this role, the ideal candidate is expected to have a solid understanding of Credit Risk Model development and delivery, data management pipeline and their related technologies. The role will be accountable for delivering implementation specifications and conduct production data assessment for any model implementations for EQB’s Advanced Internal Ratings Based (“AIRB”) approach for Pillar I regulatory capital models, the Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process (“ICAAP”) for Pillar II credit risk models, for IFRS 9 provisioning. This role will play a crucial supporting role in building an efficient way to implement risk models and risk reporting data within Equitable Bank.

Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Annotation is critical to the success of many of our computer vision projects; the annotations are used in scoring and evaluating our work as well as training our algorithms. The team uses a variety of software tools to label objects, activities, events, and other items of interest in images and video. This is an as-needed, project-dependent position with variable hours. jobs.title: Director of Agricultural Development
jobs.description_text: Rainmaker is pioneering a modern precipitation enhancement cloud seeding system to solve water scarcity. We develop and incorporate radar validation, weather-resistant UAS, and numerical weather modeling to make water abundant. As Rainmaker’s Director of Agricultural Development, you will own our engagement with the U.S. Department of Agriculture and the agricultural community in Washington. You will build the programs, partnerships, and funding pathways that connect precipitation enhancement to the conservation and water supply needs of American producers, and you will own the Congressional relationships and coalition presence that make the work durable. This position is based in Washington, DC. Significant stock options with high potential upside as an early-stage company 401(k) with employer matching Full health coverage (medical, dental, and vision insurance) Relocation assistance provided (if applicable) Unlimited PTO Paid parental leave for both parents

jobs.title: Director of International Development
jobs.description_text: Rainmaker is pioneering a modern precipitation enhancement cloud seeding system to solve water scarcity. We develop and incorporate radar validation, weather-resistant UAS, and numerical weather modeling to make water abundant. As Rainmaker’s Director of International Development, you will be the bridge between Rainmaker’s International Team and the U.S. federal government. You will own our engagement with the Department of State by building the programs, partnerships, and funding pathways that pair American precipitation enhancement technology with the water security needs of partner nations. Water scarcity is a geopolitical problem before it is a technical one. Rainmaker’s goal is to make American cloud seeding the technology partner nations turn to, and this role is how we get there in Washington. This position is based in Washington, DC and works as an embedded member of the International Team. Benefits: Significant stock options with high potential upside as an early-stage company 401(k) with employer matching Full health coverage (medical, dental, and vision insurance) Relocation assistance provided (if applicable) Unlimited PTO Paid parental leave for both parents

jobs.title: Director of Science Policy
jobs.description_text: Rainmaker is pioneering a modern precipitation enhancement cloud seeding system to solve water scarcity. We develop and incorporate radar validation, weather-resistant UAS, and numerical weather modeling to make water abundant. As Rainmaker’s Director of Science Policy, you will own our engagement with the federal science enterprise, such as DOE, NOAA, NSF, and the research offices and national laboratories that fund atmospheric science in the United States. You will find the programs where our work and their priorities meet, build the proposals that win them, and own the Congressional and community relationships that make that work durable. Rainmaker is building the best atmospheric science lab in the world. This role connects that ambition to the agencies funding the parallel research. This position is based in Washington, DC. Significant stock options with high potential upside as an early-stage company 401(k) with employer matching Full health coverage (medical, dental, and vision insurance) Relocation assistance provided (if applicable) Unlimited PTO Paid parental leave for both parents

jobs.title: Director of Water Development

Your initial focus will be on building an exposure screening product for insured fleets, enabling customers to load their insured fleet, attach policy values, and continuously monitor exposure and accumulation against the live global fleet picture. This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with underwriters, brokers, P&I clubs, claims and exposure-management teams, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure the product solves real customer problems and establishes Kpler as a trusted source of marine insurance intelligence. The role is ideal for an experienced product leader who is comfortable operating in an ambiguous, early-stage environment and has a track record of taking B2B data, analytics, or SaaS products from concept through to customer adoption.

Your initial focus will be on building live fleet monitoring and catch and yield reporting, enabling procurement and compliance teams to monitor vessels, understand fishing activity, and access reliable information to support their due-diligence and traceability requirements. This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing teams, to ensure the product delivers trusted and actionable intelligence. This is about as upstream as it gets: if the signal doesn't get captured off the device, there's no TV data downstream, and TV data is the base layer Samba's whole business is built on. Beyond the core ACR work, the team also powers mobile apps that use TV viewership data and an edge AI feature that recognizes video game titles and shoppable items showing up on screen. Q4 brings a new OEM project live - Sony's audio ACR work and the Titan OS integration are both active right now. By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier. We now serve over 12 million customers globally, are present in over 30 countries and manage a £7 billion portfolio of renewable energy assets. At Octopus, we prioritise generalists over specialists because our growth isn't limited to just one sector. We built Kraken into a £10B SaaS powerhouse, and are scaling ventures across Tech, Flexibility and Smart Heating among others. We are now looking to take our experience to new countries around the world. We are looking for someone to lead the build out forecasting and asset optimisation analytics in a new market for Octopus in East Asia. The role will cover forecasting price, generation and demand outturns. This will start off with a contained number of pilot projects to prove out the concept, but will expand to a national, multi-province approach. We envisage you spending a couple of months in Octopus HQ to get up to speed before deploying in country. This is a rare opportunity to create, build and lead a new function, targeting one of the largest opportunities in global energy.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer II - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next. These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide. This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.
